title: Region latency journey collage + visual kit for onboarding quickstart
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, brand-aligned visual kit and annotated screenshots for the Quickstart and onboarding docs that explains Redwood's region routing and latency behavior. The kit should be usable across the Quickstart landing page, in-product Getting Started modal, and the docs explainer. Focus on a single-page hero collage that communicates: how requests are routed by latency, the concept of regional fallbacks, and what users should expect (latency bands, probable routing path, example failover). Deliverable set includes static SVGs, a responsive PNG hero, one animated SVG (subtle path shimmer), and annotated console screenshots for the 'Routing' tab.
acceptance_criteria: Hero collage exported as responsive SVG and 3 PNG sizes (mobile/tablet/desktop)
One accessible animated SVG (prefers-reduced-motion friendly) that visualizes a request path shifting to a fallback region
Legend/sticker pack showing latency bands (green/yellow/orange/red) and region affinity icons exported as SVG + PNG
Three annotated console screenshots with callouts mapped to real console UI elements and alt text
Figma file with components, tokens, and a short usage doc included; engineering assets folder matches naming conventions
PR in docs repo linking the new images and copy has been created and linked in the ticket
